items.statement: The submitted calculation uses the specified neutral singlet C18H12N2S2 connectivity and verifies the E stereochemical constraints before electronic-structure work.
items.expected: Structure identity, formula, charge, multiplicity and E constraints are explicitly checked.

items.statement: The reported optimized state is validated with a vibrational analysis and imaginary-mode status.
items.expected: A stationary-point check is reported rather than assuming optimization convergence proves a minimum.

items.statement: The four requested diagnostic IR assignments are computed and compared to experiment.
items.expected: C-S, C=C, C=N and C-H stretching bands are individually identified and quantitatively compared.

items.statement: Two UV-visible bands are reported with wavelength, oscillator strength and transition character.
items.expected: The two tabulated excitations are individually represented and compared with their experimental counterparts.
